title: stdlib-function-to-ntapi-record
description: One record in reference/ground_truth.jsonl: the static set of Windows native syscalls a Python standard-library function can trigger.

syscalls.description: Native NtAPI syscalls the function may reach. Empty only if none apply.

name.description: Native syscall, Nt* naming convention, e.g. 'NtCreateFile'.

condition.description: Free-text trigger condition (Chinese). null means unconditional.

arg.description: Optional. Info-class / control argument that qualifies the syscall, e.g. 'ProcessTimes' for NtQueryInformationProcess.
